high_level_description: The image depicts two hands holding orange cards against a dark background. The card on the left is solid orange with a black, abstract, sunburst-like design in the center. The card on the right is also orange but features a white, abstract, sunburst-like design in the center. Both designs have a similar pattern of radiating lines that resemble rays of light or petals. The hands appear to be positioned as if they are about to touch or are just about to touch the cards. The lighting is focused on the cards, making them stand out prominently against the dark background.
